notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), later M1-M3 (remaining mobs). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. RESUME 2026-11-02: this run resumes the segment after the week's stop on 2026-10-29 at 17:30. The repo moved to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mashup-crafting and the worktrees to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mc-wt\<track>; briefs, logs and specs in this branch may still name C:\Dev\mashup-crafting or C:\Dev\mc-wt: use the new paths. The first cargo command in this worktree rebuilds the workspace crates because their source path changed: slow but expected, not a corrupt build. Never amend, rebase or rewrite history: the 'Unfinished:' WIP commit stays in history and its group is finished in new commits with the brief's subjects. Do not merge minecraft-survival into the branch; the orchestrator merges at the end.

groups.prompt: The commit f26f20f6 'Unfinished: Minecraft shows the held map in first person (group maps-view)' is unfinished work for this group: read it, keep what is right, and finish the group in new commits with the brief's subjects; do not rewrite history. Track E2 group maps-view. Read docs/round10/track-e.md, section E-maps, group maps-view (commit 3). One commit 'Minecraft shows the held map in first person': compose RGBA at 2x from map_background, the 62-entry MapColor palette read from MapColor.<clinit> via class_file.rs, and the decoration sprites at 8x8 map pixels rotated by rot*22.5 degrees; MinecraftUi.held_map next to the spyglass fields and a hud job; two-handed with an empty offhand, else one-handed, per javap of FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer; hide the map stack in render_anim minecraft_hand.rs held_hand_mesh with one continue right after the let Some((slot, stack)) at :176-178 (E1 edits :195 only). Tests: palette GRASS NORMAL = (109, 153, 48); the layout picks two-handed only with an empty offhand.

Track E2 group maps-colours. Read docs/round10/track-e.md, section E-maps, group maps-colours (commit 1). One commit 'Minecraft reads block map colours from the 26.3 jar': parse Blocks.<clinit> with class_file.rs, following keyframes.rs / creative_variants.rs. Cover Properties.mapColor(MapColor) and mapColor(DyeColor), the state lambdas (log axis, bed part, the rest), ofFullCopy / ofLegacyCopy and the helper builders (logs, leaves, stems, candles, shulker boxes, stained glass); missing means NONE. Result: a per-state colour id table. Tests gated on MINECRAFTOSS_ROOT: every 26.3 block state gets an id; grass_block 1, sand 2, stone 11, water 12, oak_log[axis=y] 13 and [axis=x] 34, red bed head 3.

Track E2 group maps-explore. Read docs/round10/track-e.md, section E-maps, group maps-explore (commits 2-3). Two commits: 'Minecraft maps fill in as their holder walks' (MapItem.update port for hand-held maps over HandcraftedScene: stripe by step&15, water depth and height shading, ceiling speckle, dirty patches for maps-held, colours from maps-colours) and 'Minecraft empty maps turn into maps of where you stand' (minecraft:map use in actions.rs as EmptyMapItem.use: scale 0, tracking on, unlimited off, the take_result sound, hand replacement or add to inventory). Tests as listed (a flat grass stub fills the stripe for step&15 only; an empty map leaves 1 fewer map and a filled_map centred by create_fresh).

Track E2 group ti4-end-targets, optional but wanted this run (the week has just started). Read docs/round10/track-e.md, section E-thrown, group ti4. One commit 'Minecraft snowballs and tridents hit end crystals and the ender dragon': end_crystal.rs END_TARGET id range below FRAME_TARGET, end_targets(crystals, dragons) from the crystal pick box and ender_dragon::part_box, EndTarget::of_target; tick_thrown and tick_tridents add them, a hit runs end_hit with EndDamage::attack(amount, owner). Snowball/egg/pearl 0 (breaks a crystal), trident 8, wind charge 1, splash potions break without hurting. Test: snowball breaks a crystal, trident 8 to the head and 3 to the body.
